# Balor walks into a defense, military & security firm

Walk into any defense, military & security outfit and watch for ten minutes. You will see a very old act performed with newer props. The act has a name. It is **Balor**.

## Before the Office, the Story

**Balor Son of Dot, Grandson of Nét.** The book of invasions fixes Balor's place before it tells his deeds: Balor mac Doit meic Néit, 'Balor son of Dot, grandson of Nét', king of the Fomorians — the sea-going race who had pressed on Ireland since the age of the Nemedians, exacting tribute from the outer islands.  His wife was Cethlenn of the crooked teeth, and it was her spear, or the wound she dealt at Mag Tuired, that killed the Dagda at the Brug years later — the Lebor Gabála records the All-Father's death from Cethlenn's blow as the long-settled price of Balor's war. His daughter was Ethniu, and she was given to Cian, son of Dian Cécht the healer; their son was Lugh, the Samildánach, equally skilled in all arts.

**How the Eye Was Poisoned.** Cath Maige Tuired explains the weapon before it uses it.  Balor had a destructive eye, never opened except on a battlefield, and four men were needed to raise its lid with a polished handle that passed through it.  Any army that eye looked upon was made worthless, though it were many thousands strong.

## The Reveal, Seat by Seat

### Defense, Military & Security

*The eye that blasts armies when its lid is raised — the Fomorian superweapon.* The match is not poetic license. Strip the trade to its function and the function is the myth.

### Optics, Imaging & Vision

*The Evil Eye itself — the gaze as weapon, the watch that kills.* The match is not poetic license. Strip the trade to its function and the function is the myth.

### Disaster Resilience & Recovery

Now read the why-line with the office in mind: *The tower that fulfills the prophecy it was built to prevent — containment engineering failing on schedule.* The people doing this work did not borrow the archetype. They re-derived it — the way Balor was always going to be re-derived wherever destruction, evil eye, fomorians matters.

## Not the First Rebrand

Balor's clearest cross-border witnesses are comparative, not cognate.  The Welsh corpus preserves no figure derived from the same name — the Brythonic silence is total, as it is for so many of the Fomorian cycle. The office is only the latest translation.
